useCases.title: Summarise a long contract or vendor agreement
useCases.message: Help me review a contract or vendor agreement. Ask me which document to look at. Then read through it and pull out the key clauses covering obligations, renewal terms, exit conditions, and anything that looks unusual or worth questioning before signing.
